body: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE neutral standing CHILD Yuuki game sprite for design approval; NOT an animation sheet. Image 1 is the existing older Yuuki, a reference for her identity and the detailed chibi pixel RPG art style. Reimagine Yuuki at NINE YEARS OLD: visibly smaller, short and petite child body with a round child face, large clear RED eyes, softly rounded cheeks, a slightly oversized head and short child limbs, about 2.6 heads tall. Long pure WHITE hair to waist, soft fringe and a small simple black bow/cross hair ornament. A modest everyday black-and-white dress appropriate to a poor angel child: white Peter Pan collar, covered chest, short puff sleeves, black bodice with a tiny white cross motif, knee-length white skirt edged with black lace, opaque white knee socks and plain worn black Mary Jane shoes. Same visual family as the reference, but simpler everyday clothes, not a tiny adult or noble ballgown. Calm curious gentle expression, hands relaxed at sides, both feet planted, FRONT view from the game's slightly elevated camera; both wings visible. EXACT anatomy: her anatomical LEFT wing is BLACK, appearing on the VIEWER'S RIGHT; her anatomical RIGHT wing is WHITE, appearing on the VIEWER'S LEFT. Each wing is a single coherent color, smaller soft folded child angel wings. No weapons of any kind, no staff, no staff tip behind hair, no quiver, no toys. NO HALO AT ALL: the halo is a separate game layer created later. Clear empty space above her hair. Fully contained feet and wingtips with generous transparent margin, no text, no duplicates, no environment, no ground plane or shadow. Crisp detailed pixel-art clusters and readable contours with shaded fabric/feather volume matching the reference, no blurry strands, no motion blur. Genuine transparent background, single character and single pose.
halo: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a SINGLE original magical HALO sprite, isolated on genuinely transparent background, for a pixel-art angel RPG. No person, no head, no hair, no text or labels, no duplicates. Design an ORIGINAL recognizable signature for Yuuki: a slender open elliptical crown seen in a slightly elevated three-quarter perspective, composed of two interrupted concentric arcs, a small suspended diamond at the FRONT midpoint, and a pair of short abstract feather-shaped angular fins extending from the left and right arc ends. The left fin has two short notches, the right fin has three: subtle recognizable asymmetry, not a generic gold ring. Spacious empty center. Low horizontal silhouette, wider than tall; elegant and very readable when reduced to about 80 pixels wide above a character's head. Blue Archive is inspiration ONLY for the idea of an individual geometric luminous signature; do NOT reproduce any of its existing character halos or symbols. This halo's shape must also suit Yuuki as an adult later. Strictly NEUTRAL GRAYSCALE palette: pearl WHITE main strokes and light-gray inner shading; no gold, no blue, no colored cast. We will tint this exact sprite freely at runtime, so its geometry and all details must be retained in one neutral texture. Clear thickness, crisp game-pixel cluster edges, no huge soft bloom, no starfield or scattered sparkles. Subtle luminous quality confined tightly to the strokes, no outer aura. Entire isolated design centered in the canvas with generous transparent margins. One halo only.
status: Yuuki child design pending validation; animations not started.
